text:
deploy-bot: Release attempt v2026-04-15 CANARY flagged: 0/3 instances passing healthcheck in us-west-2-canary. Reason: keystore lookup 404 for kv prefix 'prod/app/'. Logs: https://ci/release/987/logs

alex: looking at the logs now — the code asks for key 'prod/app/config:token' but staging used 'app/config:token'. prefix mismatch.

priya: we changed values.secretPrefix in prod helm values last week to 'prod/app/'. staging and canary still use 'app/'. forgot to update preflight.

mike: commit 9f3d4b7 altered secretPrefix for prod-only rollout. I missed a follow-up migration.

sasha: canary healthchecks dropped within 2 minutes of traffic shift. Do we want to rollback canary or patch-in-place?

alex: rollback to the previous image tag (1.3.2) and pin till we have parity check in CI. safer.

priya: agreed. also add a warning in release notes: do not change secretPrefix without running migration script. :warning:

mike: initiating rollback now, pinning canary to 1.3.2 and setting weight -> 0.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by mike at 2026-04-15T12:17:23Z. Canary weight set to 0. Restoring previous traffic routing.

alex: I'll open a hotfix branch to add a preflight that asserts keystore prefixes match across envs.

priya: tiny snippet from logs that shows the 404:
```
keystore.get("prod/app/config:token") -> 404 NotFound
keystore.get("app/config:token") -> 200 OK
```

mike: adding to action list: pin image, backfill migration for existing keys, add preflight parity check, update release checklist.

eng-release-oncall: booking postmortem slot 2026-04-16 10:00 PT. Please include rollout timeline and terraform/helm diffs.

alex: I'll update the release notes and change window owners. sending a short note to PM + infra to freeze config merges until parity tests land.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed. Previous cluster state restored. Monitoring shows canary instances healthy on tag 1.3.2. :white_check_mark:

priya: found probable root cause — prod stores some secrets base64-encoded in the keystore; staging kept plaintext. migration scripts expect encoded values. we need to standardize encoding in preflight.

sasha: follow-ups captured in ticket REL-432: 1) add parity preflight job 2) migration script to re-encode prod keys consistently 3) enforce helm values sync 4) update release checklist + docs

mike: thanks all. once PR #1234 (preflight) merges and we confirm no config drift, we can unfreeze and re-run canary with the corrected values.

alex: ack — will update thread when PR is merged and after a successful dry-run canary.

priya: small note for next time — include a quick helm diff step in deploybot output to surface value changes between envs. that would've flagged this earlier.

eng-release-oncall: agreed. moving to follow-up. closing this thread after PR merge and postmortem.

alex: thanks everyone.
